title: Design: Min Stack (struct)
hints: Store the running minimum alongside each pushed value.
Push the pair `(value, min(value, previous min))`; the minimum is always on top.
`items.append((x, Swift.min(x, items.last?.min ?? x)))` and `func min() -> Int? { items.last?.min }`.
jsBridge: The same algorithm as in JS (a parallel stack of running minimums). Swift makes it a `struct` with `mutating` methods, so a `MinStack` copy is independent. In JS, two variables would share one stack object.

compass.q: Struct `MinStack` vs class: what does copying a struct stack cost thanks to copy-on-write?
